LanguageData.MutationBloatedHeart.label: Bloated Heart
LanguageData.MutationBloatedHeart.description: The heart has transformed into a bloated fortress of blood. Colonist enjoys an immense increase in blood pumping capacity, and damage to the body produces large pools of blood.
LanguageData.MutationBrain.label: Brain Mutation
LanguageData.MutationBrain.description: Colonist's brain has mutated, causing the synapses to fire quicker and more efficiently, making him perform better overall.
LanguageData.MutationBrainDamage.label: Brain Damage
LanguageData.MutationBrainDamage.description: Colonist's brain tissue has deteriorated, causing the synapses to fire slower and less efficiently, causing him to become deaf and mute.
LanguageData.MutationDamagedHearing.label: Damaged Hearing
LanguageData.MutationDamagedHearing.description: Colonist's ears have been damaged leaving him with poor hearing.
LanguageData.MutationDamagedLung.label: Damaged Lungs
LanguageData.MutationDamagedLung.description: The radiation has destroyed much of colonist's lung tissue making it difficult for him to breathe.
LanguageData.MutationDamagedVision.label: Damaged Vision
LanguageData.MutationDamagedVision.description: Colonist's eye tissue has been damaged, leaving his eye useless. If both eyes are damaged, colonist will go blind.
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedHearing.label: Enhanced Hearing
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedHearing.description: Colonist's ears have mutated, allowing him to hear more clearly and sharply. This allows him to have better reflexes.
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedLungs.label: Enhanced Lungs
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedLungs.description: The radiation has strengthened the tissues and muscle in colonist's lungs and diaphram, causing his breathing to become unhuman.
LanguageData.MutationStrengthenedHeart.label: Strengthened Heart
LanguageData.MutationStrengthenedHeart.description: The muscle tissue has woven itself in such a way that colonist's heart has strengthened and become superior.
LanguageData.MutationSuperVision.label: Super Vision
LanguageData.MutationSuperVision.description: Colonist's eye has mutated, allowing him to see more clearly and sharply. This allows colonist to have better reflexes and improves perception.
LanguageData.MutationWeakenedHeart.label: Weakened Heart
LanguageData.MutationWeakenedHeart.description: The muscle tissue has been weakened and damaged by the radiation, making colonist's body part less efficient and damaged.
